text:
michelle: quick heads-up — I'm on deck for the 00:00–08:00 shift tonight. want to confirm everyone has pager + vpn + runbook access. i'll do a quick smoke before handoff at 23:45. if you can't, please ping.

raj: i'm green for VPN but haven't re-provisioned my MFA token since rotation. steps?

michelle: @raj re-mint via idp portal -> Devices -> Remove old -> Re-register. if you run into okta errors, DM infra. also test with `ssh bastion.redwood.internal` & `curl -I https://console.redwood` :thumbsup:

olivia: tested vpn + bastion from home (macOS) 10m ago. pager test failed once, but fixed after re-installing mobile app. command i ran:
```
oncall test-pager --user olivia --method sms
# expected: "pager test delivered" 
```

leo: checked runbooks: https://rwd.infra/runbooks/oncall/night — fyi the "model-oom" runbook has a new step to rotate jobsets. added note.

infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-4821 updated: Pager provider cert rotated. Please re-check subscriptions.

oncall-ops: michelle — quick reminder: update the "backup contact" field in PagerDuty if you're traveling. Also confirm KMS access:
`aws kms list-keys --region us-west-2 --profile oncall`
If that returns keys you're good.

raj: thanks, will re-register and run the test.

michelle: if anyone's remaining blockers by 23:30, drop them here. otherwise i'll post the handoff summary at 23:50 with who is primary/secondary and any special notes (limited GPU capacity in us-west tonight). :white_check_mark:

olivia: small FYI — scheduled infra patch window 01:00–01:20 in us-west; nonbreaking but might bump latency. noted in runbook.

michelle: noted. thanks all. i'll post final check at 23:50.
